criteria.description: Terminology: five accurate definitions/analogies worth 2 each (1 meaning, 1 analogy with mapping).

criteria.feedback: Missing or incorrect prediction. Trace the example and check JSON types, then retry.

criteria.description: In practice.js declare shopName with const and stock with let. Update stock, then demonstrate a caught reassignment error for a const binding in a separate example. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Convert "200" and "3" to numbers and calculate 600. Check Number.isFinite after conversion and reject a nonnumeric value; explain why empty text needs an explicit rule. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Implement stockLabel(stock) returning out for 0, low for 1 through 5 and available above 5. Demonstrate 0,1,5,6. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Create an array of three product objects with id, name, price and stock. Update only the second product and show all records before/after. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Implement inventoryValue(products) returning the sum of price*stock and 0 for empty input. Use Pen 200/10 and Book 500/3 to expect 3500. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Implement findProduct(products,id) and document missing-result behaviour. Test first, last and absent IDs without changing the array. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Create index.html with a labelled quantity input, button and output element. Load practice.js and display a calculated total on click; show an invalid-input message. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).
Independent verification: new normal case (3), boundary/failure case (3), reproducible commands and observed outputs (2), limitation and repair plan (2).
